title: Compile the common twirl uniformly without enumerating an irrep
statement: Canonical highest-weight GT string plus inverse small-dimensional Schur and one COMMON finite Gaussian/polar unitary on every carrier replaces fixed-rank irrep enumeration. Rational near-unitary X is compiled through pivoted QR with ||V-U||<=2sqrt(r||X-U||), paid denominator/bit bounds and finite known gates. The correct error is a reference-safe averaged CHANNEL coupling, not total variation of a finite seed to continuous Haar. Discard the seed; only the final unconditional global phase is irrelevant.
